title: Matter ejections behind the highs and lows of the transitional millisecond pulsar PSR J1023+0038
question: What is the root cause of the mode changes in the active sub-luminous X-ray state of PSR J1023+0038 and its implication for accretion-ejection coupling in X-ray binary systems harbouring rapidly spinning neutron stars?

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA Band 3 continuum and measure source properties
recipe.method: Calibrate using the ALMA pipeline in CASA, image continuum with interactive tclean using manual mask and primary beam correction with both natural and Briggs robust=0 weighting, and fit 2D Gaussian functions to the robust=0 image to obtain positions, peak intensities, integrated fluxes, and deconvolved sizes. Image lower and upper sidebands separately to compute in-band spectral index.
key_parameters: LSB central frequency 91.47886 GHz, USB central frequency 103.5115 GHz

recipe.goal: Extract ALMA millimetre light curves, mode-resolved fluxes, and short flare properties
recipe.method: Produce natural-weighted images scan by scan (~4–5 min), during X-ray high and low mode time intervals (selected from NICER light curves with 2.5 counts s^-1 threshold), and over short time intervals (15 s) to search for flares; measure peak intensities, flux densities above 3sigma, and fit 2D Gaussians to flares.
key_parameters: NICER threshold 2.5 counts s^-1 for high/low mode selection
3sigma detection threshold; 15 s intervals for peak flare measurements

recipe.goal: Process multi-wavelength X-ray, UV, optical, NIR, polarimetric, and radio observations
recipe.method: Reduce and extract light curves, spectra, photometry, polarimetry, and pulsar searches from XMM-Newton, NuSTAR, HST, NTT/SOFI, VLA, FAST, NICER, Swift, REM, and VLT/FORS2 following standard and literature prescriptions.
key_parameters: VLA 60 s image intervals with niters=10, cycleniter=10; 3sigma detection threshold
VLT/FORS2 80 s combined bins, 2sigma detection threshold for LP
assumptions: FAST pulse duty cycle between 0.05–0.3, DM range 3–100 pc cm^-3

recipe.goal: Measure X-ray low-mode ingress and egress timescales
recipe.method: Fit a four-component piecewise linear model (constant entrance high mode, linear ingress, constant low mode, linear egress, constant exit high mode) to 56 low-mode episodes in XMM-Newton and 10 in NICER 10 s binned light curves.

recipe.goal: Model millimetre/radio flares with expanding plasma blob and constrain mass transfer rate from radio non-detection
recipe.method: Calculate flare light curves at ALMA Band 3 and VLA Band X using the van der Laan (1966) expanding plasma blob model. Estimate lower limit on companion mass transfer rate by requiring free-free absorption optical depth tau_ff >= 1 at 1.25 GHz.
key_parameters: v approx 0.05 c, B ~ 10^5 G at launch scaling as R^-1, n_e = 10^11 - 10^12 cm^-3

recipe.goal: Simultaneous MCMC modelling of high-mode and low-mode broadband SEDs
recipe.method: De-redden NIR/optical/UV fluxes, construct mode-resolved SEDs from radio to X-rays, and perform simultaneous MCMC sampling of the high-mode model (irradiated star + multi-colour disc + compact jet broken power law + shock synchrotron) and low-mode model (irradiated star + multi-colour disc + compact jet broken power law + discrete ejecta optically thin power law).
assumptions: D = 1368 pc, R_c = 0.43 R_sun, eta_* = 0.1, M_NS = 1.65 M_sun, M_C = 0.24 M_sun, P_orb = 4.75 hrs, L_irr = 6.5 x 10^33 erg s^-1, disc albedo = 0.95, mass transfer rate = 10^-11 M_sun yr^-1

recipe.goal: Fit the millimetre-X-ray luminosity correlation for black hole XRBs and compare with J1023
recipe.method: Perform Bayesian MCMC linear regression on log L_mm vs log L_X for black hole XRBs (including upper limits) using LINMIX_ERR with 10^4 posterior draws.
key_parameters: 10^4 draws from posterior distribution; L_mm,ave = 10^31.93 erg s^-1, L_X,ave = 10^38.03 erg s^-1
assumptions: Flat spectrum assumed to evaluate 100 GHz luminosity where literature flux is at other frequencies (except alpha=0.25 for MAXI J1820+070 and alpha=0.13 for 4U 1820-30)
